facts.fact: The GRA Commissioner General said the Integrated Tax Administration System, being introduced ahead of nationwide implementation, will integrate with the national identification database for taxpayer identification.

GMB.note: The national ID database is named only as an integration target; nothing on the system itself.

facts.fact: The GRA unveiled ITAS at two stakeholder workshops ahead of nationwide implementation, a platform to automate tax registration, filing and payment across income tax, VAT, customs and excise, with web and mobile e-services.

The Gambia Revenue Authority introduced its Integrated Tax Administration System to stakeholders at two workshops ahead of nationwide implementation, to automate registration, filing, payment and auditing.
The GRA's ITAS, being rolled out nationwide, covers taxpayer registration across all taxpayer categories and is to integrate with the national identification database for taxpayer identification.
